from pathlib import Path

pat=bytes.fromhex('0606017f0041010b')

print('global sec', sec)
# replace init expr with 5 bytes and bump section size
idx=data.find(bytes.fromhex('41010b'))
print('global expr', idx)
data[idx:idx+3]=bytes.fromhex('410141020b')
data[sec+1]=0x08
# locate data section start by pattern 0b 0b 01 00 41 02 0b 05
pat2=bytes.fromhex('0b0b010041020b05')

idx=data.find(bytes.fromhex('41020b'))
print('data expr', idx)
data[idx:idx+3]=bytes.fromhex('410241030b')
data[sec2+1]=0x0d
out=Path('/workspace/poc2.wasm')
out.write_bytes(data)
print('wrote', out, len(data))
